candidate: uncommitted T034 working-tree successor on the accepted baseline (HEAD == baseline); reviewed read-only before any commit.
review_type: fresh pinned read-only DeepSeek internal review of the T034 second-provider replaceability, version-rejection, and failure-isolation candidate

checks.name: baseline identity, boundary, reviewed-path exactness, and clean diff
checks.command_or_evidence: git rev-parse HEAD; git diff --name-only <baseline> --; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; git diff --check <baseline> --
checks.measured: HEAD == baseline; candidate union = 99 paths; git diff --check clean; the only shared files changed are src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt (additive T034 foreach block only), specs/007-xcom-core/tasks.md (T034 checkbox only), engineering/trace/links.json (additive T034 links plus the inherited CMakeLists implemented_by digest refresh), engineering/project.json, engineering/verification/measures/{unit,integration,validation}.json, engineering/stage-results/*.json (inherited CMakeLists/links/measure digest refresh only), and reports/review-index.md
checks.observation: The reviewed-path list is exactly the tracked-baseline diff union the untracked candidate files, excluding only docs/engineering/xcom/t034/internal-review.json and reports/xcom-queue/t034-package.json, which the package stage emits later.

checks.name: three additive t034-<kind> targets build and pass
checks.command_or_evidence: cmake --build build/fabro-t030-t034-system-unit --parallel 4; ctest --test-dir build/fabro-t030-t034-system-unit -L t034- --output-on-failure; ctest --test-dir build/fabro-t030-t034-system-unit -N -L t034-
checks.measured: 100% tests passed, 0 failed out of 13 (4 t034-replaceability, 5 t034-version, 4 t034-isolation); ctest -N -L t034- reports Total Tests: 13
checks.observation: The fixture and the three drivers compile under the accepted warning-as-error profile and every t034- case passes deterministically in-process with no wall-clock, network, or environment dependence.

checks.name: preserved inherited suites and Python suite
checks.command_or_evidence: ctest --test-dir build/fabro-t030-t034-system-unit -L 't0(20|2[6-9]|3[0-4])-'; ctest --test-dir build/fabro-t030-t034-system-unit -N; python3 -m pytest -q
checks.measured: inherited/t034 labels: 100% tests passed, 0 failed out of 242; full discovery Total Tests: 496; pytest 150 passed, 24 subtests passed
checks.observation: No existing target, test name, label, command, or expected value changed; the 496 full discovery equals the pre-T034 483 plus the 13 new t034- cases.

checks.name: replaceability reuses the unchanged T033 provider contract suite
checks.measured: provider_contract_suite.hpp, suite_support.hpp, and core_matrix/test_support.hpp are unmodified; the suite body names no concrete provider type and is instantiated only through the new SyntheticProviderSubject adapter; P-01..P-13 pass on the second provider
checks.observation: The second provider is validated by the same reusable suite body that the accepted loopback provider passes, which is exactly the accepted provider-contract replaceability claim.

checks.name: fail-closed version and capability rejection with zero emission
checks.measured: a 2.0.0 provider is rejected at registration with unsupported_contract_version and no handle; a 9.9.9 request is rejected before activation with unsupported_contract_version; a storage-exceeding descriptor is rejected with invalid_descriptor; an unadvertised reliable request is rejected with unsupported_delivery; accepted_item_count() stays 0 and no submit is dispatched on each rejection
checks.observation: Every rejection path is fail-closed before provider dispatch and mutates no operational state; SyntheticProvider::descriptor_compatible() intentionally does not check the version so the version gate remains owned by the accepted composition registration (provider.cpp:407) and preparation (provider.cpp:503) gates.

checks.name: failure isolation of an unrelated route
checks.measured: a forced prepare/submit failure returns its exact stable outcome with zero emission; an unrelated active loopback route stays active with queued_items()==1 and queue_capacity()==2, accepts a further item, and returns its exact retained item; a rejected (2.0.0) adapter registered into the same composition leaves the unrelated route active and able to return its exact item; route_state() and reconcile_route() stay observable and consistent
checks.observation: Containment is bounded to the accepted single-registry composition model, consistent with T034-GAP-02.

checks.name: additive build wiring and unchanged runtime inventory
checks.command_or_evidence: git diff <baseline> -- src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt; the generated xcom-runtime-contract.json and xcom_build_contract target
checks.measured: the diff adds one additive T034 foreach block containing exactly add_executable and gtest_discover_tests (no add_library); the fixture source is compiled into the three test executables and no runtime library is added; the generated runtime contract still lists the same 11 runtime_targets; the build-contract verifier passes during configure
checks.observation: No existing target, label, command, or expected value changes and no existing discovery count is reduced.

checks.name: public safety, forbidden-API, and Doxygen file blocks
checks.command_or_evidence: grep for AF_INET/AF_INET6/socket/listen/connect/resolver/getaddrinfo/TLS/SSL over the new fixture and drivers; reading the file headers
checks.measured: the only match for the forbidden vocabulary is a prose sentence in the header stating what the fixture does not do; no network, DNS, resolver, TLS, external-peer, legacy-binary, or production-workload use; every new fixture/driver file carries the @file/@brief/@ownership/@lifetime/@thread_safety/@failure block (and @bounds plus @par Traceability on the drivers); no payload byte, permit content, secret, private address, or host path is committed
checks.observation: The fixture exercises no such API.

checks.name: traceability completeness and validity
checks.measured: 653 artifacts and 2329 links validate with no error; every accepted T034-SR-0{01..14} carries refines, allocated_to, implemented_by, and verified_by; every T034-SR-*-U carries decomposes_to, implemented_by, verified_by, and analyzed_by; T034-VS-ACCUMULATED validates all 14 software requirements; every implemented_by target_revision equals the current file hash
checks.observation: The inherited CMakeLists implemented_by digests were refreshed to the new bytes; no link identity or relation of a predecessor changed.

checks.name: governance records, REF-002, and maturity
checks.command_or_evidence: engineering/project.json; the T007-T010 registers; the T034 tasks.md line; the recorded stage model
checks.measured: project.json feature.task_id == T034 and baseline == the accepted baseline; no accepted register was edited; T034 is marked complete only at implementation and T035-T041 remain allocated; the reported stage model is deepseek-v4-flash; REF-002 remains unchanged with an empty promoted list
checks.observation: No acceptance or compatibility claim is made; external Codex review and user acceptance remain T039/T041 and are deferred until the backlog completes.

checks.name: application of the transport/deadline/isolation review charge
checks.command_or_evidence: reading the fixture and drivers; the CMake registration; the inherited T030/T031/T032 records
checks.measured: T034 is an in-process fixture task: it opens no TCP listener and uses no AF_INET/DNS/TLS/separate-process path (REV-08); resources are compile-time bounded (kMaximumRoutes=2, kMaximumQueueItems=8) and descriptor_compatible() admits only in-bounds descriptors; flow control is the reject-new queue_saturated path; disconnect cleanup is the bounded drain/close lifecycle; version rejection and provider isolation are asserted by the t034- cases. Wall-clock deadlines and separate-process behavior are not applicable to this in-process slice and belong to the read-only T031/T032 records.
checks.observation: No requirement, check, or malformed/over-bound negative path applicable to this slice is left unasserted by the thirteen cases.

observations: The second provider adds three bounded, non-sensitive observation accessors (prepare_dispatch_count, submit_dispatch_count, accepted_item_count) beyond the design's forced-failure seam so the T034-SR-008 emission count and the zero-emission criterion are asserted deterministically; this mirrors the accepted T016 ProbeProvider counter precedent and changes no requirement, check, expected value, or accepted contract.

Non-normative design shorthand: detailed-design.md section 3 lists 'prepare after activation -> inactive_route'; the implementation, like the accepted loopback provider (loopback_provider.cpp:54-59 vs synthetic_provider.cpp:84-89), returns route_mismatch for a re-prepare of the same live route_id, and the accepted T033 suite does not exercise this path. It is a summary-table wording nuance with no requirement, check, test, or expected value impact, so it is recorded here rather than as a blocking finding.

Instance-identity disjointness is guaranteed by construction from a disjoint high counter base rather than by an absolute wraparound proof; for the bounded in-process tests this is deterministic and sufficient.
limitations: T034-GAP-01: replaceability is proven only against owned in-process synthetic providers.
T034-GAP-02: isolation is bounded to the accepted single-registry/single-active-route composition model.
T034-GAP-03: the admitted envelope still cannot link the gRPC transport runtime (T032-GAP-01).
T034-GAP-04: no deployed-service, runtime-success, compatibility, or production-readiness claim is made.
method: Read-only inspection of the exact candidate path union, the additive versus accepted diffs, the new fixture and drivers, the unchanged T033 suite header, the additive CMake block, the generated runtime contract, the trace graph, the register records, and the executed t034- and inherited test outcomes; no file was modified during the review.
